title: Common definitions
description: Definitions shared by the other schemas through $ref: one fact, one place.

key.description: Key; slash-separated safe segments, no leading slash and no .. segments.

relativePath.description: Relative path that cannot be absolute, start with ~, contain .. segments, backslashes or control characters.

baseModel.description: Base (cloning) model used to produce lines.

testText.description: Test sentence spoken in every take of a voice.

device.description: Engine device as in the machine profile, for example cpu or Vulkan0. The same seed gives different takes on different devices (D16).
